attributes.description: Gujarat Mineral Development Corporation Ltd is a Government of Gujarat enterprise engaged primarily in mining and marketing lignite and other industrial minerals, alongside a 250 MW lignite-based thermal plant, 200.9 MW of wind farms and a 5 MW solar plant. Its Odisha coal mines and new lignite, limestone, rare-earth and copper projects remain under development rather than commercial operation.[1][2][3]
